nodes.name: AboutUsStyles.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the About Us page section with a three-column grid layout displaying company information cards with typography and responsive breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with CSS custom properties for theming (color-paper, color-ink) and responsive clamp() functions for fluid sizing.

nodes.name: AddLocationForm.css
nodes.summary: Modal dialog styles for adding a new mountain location, featuring a two-column form grid, photo upload section with URL/file toggle, and action buttons.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS modal overlay using backdrop-filter blur, CSS custom properties for theming, and responsive form grid collapsing to single column on mobile.

nodes.name: AddUserForm.css
nodes.summary: Modal dialog styles for the user registration form, featuring a single-column layout with form groups, validation error states, and submit/cancel actions.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS modal with dark overlay backdrop, form input focus states using box-shadow ring, and error message styling in red tones.

nodes.name: ContactFormStyles.css
nodes.summary: Page-level contact form styles with a prominent header, form fields for text input and textarea, submit button with hover effects, and inline validation error display.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with large display typography using clamp(), form focus states with box-shadow rings, and hover transform on buttons.

nodes.name: DestinationStyles.css
nodes.summary: Styles for the destination page featuring hero sections with two-column grid layouts for alternating text and image blocks, decorative overlays, and responsive stacking on mobile.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with decorative pseudo-element overlays, alternating grid direction via reverse class, and repeating linear gradient patterns for texture.

nodes.name: EditLocationForm.css
nodes.summary: Modal dialog styles for editing an existing mountain location, nearly identical to AddLocationForm with a two-column form grid, photo management, and update/cancel actions.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS modal with backdrop-filter blur, form grid responsive collapse, and image preview container with rounded corners.

nodes.name: EditUserForm.css
nodes.summary: Modal dialog styles for editing user profile, featuring form fields with optional/required labels, a collapsible password section, and submit/cancel action buttons.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS modal with optional field indicator via pseudo-element content, password toggle section with border separator, and focus ring states.

nodes.name: FooterStyles.css
nodes.summary: Footer component styles with a brand section containing logo and company name, social media icon links with hover effects, and a three-column navigation grid.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with dark gradient background, social icon hover with border color and translateY transitions, and responsive single-column stacking on mobile.

nodes.name: HeroStyles.css
nodes.summary: Hero section styles for full-viewport and mid-height hero variants with background image overlay, kicker label, statistics row, and responsive typography.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with layered pseudo-element gradients, decorative repeating-linear-gradient pattern overlay, and CSS animation for spinner keyframe.

nodes.name: ImageModalStyles.css
nodes.summary: Lightweight modal overlay for displaying images in full-screen with a dark backdrop, centered image content, and a positioned close button.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS fixed-position overlay with flexbox centering, high z-index for stacking, and close button positioned absolutely outside the image bounds.

nodes.name: MountainCardStyles.css
nodes.summary: Card component styles for mountain listings with image, difficulty badge overlay, location, stats, and rating display, featuring hover lift animation and image zoom.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with cubic-bezier easing for smooth transitions, overflow hidden for image zoom effect, flexbox column layout for card structure, and rating stars styling.

nodes.name: MountainDetailsStyles.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive stylesheet for the mountain detail page including hero section, two-column content grid, weather widget, review panel, guidance list, and alternative mountains grid.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with complex multi-column grids, overlapping hero overlay with negative margin, practical facts grid with icon alignment, and tag pill styling for mountain metadata.

nodes.name: NavbarStyles.css
nodes.summary: Sticky navigation bar styles with brand mark, centered menu links, search dropdown with results, authentication button, and mobile-responsive hamburger menu.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with sticky positioning, multi-column grid layout, search results dropdown with overflow scroll, mobile menu toggle via active class, and search spinner animation.
